notes.title: Update 3.3.1
notes.notes:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

Thank you for enjoying From Madness with Love.



Today, we've rolled out an update that addresses the following issues.



Update 3.3.1:

(Japanese version) Fixed an issue where the player's first person pronoun would become "washi" regardless of player choice.

(English version) Fixed an endgame issue where Aorta's dialogue would not display and the game would freeze.

Fixed an issue where all dialogue options at the end of the game would lead to the additional ending of the DLC.

Fixed an issue where Aorta's voice lines did not match the actual dialogue.



We hope you'll continue to support From Madness with Love!

notes.title: 3.2.4 Update
notes.notes:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

We have updated the game to version 3.2.4.

This update fixes a bug that caused save data created before the previous update (3.2.3) to disappear upon launching the game after updating. In the case that you have created save data before the update and never played the update itself, you should be able to load the files with no issue.

Unfortunately however, this update will not be able to restore save data that was lost because of this bug.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue.

We hope you continue to enjoy and support From Madness with Love.
